create_metric_value: create a MetricValue instance with a numeric value and maximize flag for optimization tracking
compare_metric_values: compare two MetricValue instances using greater than to determine which is better
check_is_worst: check if a MetricValue is the worst possible value using the is_worst property
add_value_to_metric: add a float value to an existing MetricValue using the add_value method
create_worst_metric_value: create a WorstMetricValue instance to represent an invalid or buggy solution metric
